snippet.title: All the Presents! Trailer | Help Santa Climb for Christmas
snippet.description:
Tilt your phone to steer Santa up illustrated Christmas worlds. Tap as he lands for a Carol Jump: eight in a row and Pip's sleigh drops Presents for you.

More at https://allthepresents.com
